title: Warm Peppery Australian Pumpkin Pie
description: A savory, single-serving Australian hand pie featuring rich pumpkin spiced with a heavy hand of black pepper and flamed with brandy.

ingredients.name: Kabocha pumpkin
ingredients.notes: peeled and cut into small cubes

ingredients.name: Puff pastry
ingredients.notes: rolled to a five inch square

instructions: Preheat your oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit and line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
Melt the butter in a small skillet over medium heat and add the cubed pumpkin.
Saute the pumpkin for eight minutes until the edges are golden and starting to soften.
Add the cracked black pepper and salt to the skillet and stir well to coat the pumpkin.
Pour the brandy into the skillet and ignite it carefully with a long match to flambe the mixture.
Once the flames die down, stir in the heavy cream and mash the pumpkin slightly with a fork.
Spoon the warm pumpkin mixture onto one half of the puff pastry square, leaving a half-inch border.
Fold the pastry over the filling to create a triangle and crimp the edges tightly with a fork.
Brush the top of the pastry with the beaten egg and cut a small slit for steam to escape.
Bake for twenty minutes until the pastry is puffed and deep golden brown.
